Wugong scenic-map height grid, sampled 2026-10-17.

Dataset: Terrain Tiles, Mapzen, a Linux Foundation project.
Source: https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/
Terrarium endpoint: https://elevation-tiles-prod.s3.amazonaws.com/terrarium/{z}/{x}/{y}.png
Attribution and license: https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md

SRTM and GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
Original elevation bounds: 114.085–114.22 E, 27.420–27.600 N.

Changes: resampled to a numeric 241 × 281 height grid, scenic northern-face cut,
vertically exaggerated projection, original lighting, vegetation and color.
The hiking route and landmark display positions are artistic composition data.
The distributed file contains elevations, not a painted map background.
